newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt, Italy presidents hold Mideast talks in Cairo.
newsitem.headline: Egypt, Italy presidents hold Mideast talks in Cairo.

text.p: Italian President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro met Egypt's Hosni Mubarak on Saturday for talks on the stalled Middle East peace process, officials said.
They said the two leaders would also discuss bilateral relations and how the European Union could help reactivate Arab-Israeli peace talks.
Arab countries have welcomed a greater role for Europe in the peace talks, largely mediated by the United States.
Scalfaro, who ends his two-day visit on Saturday, went to see the graves of Italian soldiers killed during the battle of el-Alamein, near Alexandria, in 1942.
Scalfaro is also due to meet members of the Egyptian parliament and Arab League Secretary General Esmat Abdel-Meguid.
